h1: The slate has signals, not demand
room_line: Test the nearest purchase signal against concentrated reach; resolve affinity and prestige separately.
coming_kick: KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH has the slate's only observed sessions; HASUT's larger public peaks are creator-linked and less purchase-proximate.
coming_caveat: Private booking and final eligibility remain unresolved for all four titles, while no SAMS presales or paid admissions were supplied.
signal_note: Social samples are not cross-title comparable; use them to diagnose each campaign’s shape, not rank demand.

eligibility.basis: The title is absent from the captured SAMS public Coming surface, and no explicit current Akhil or Programming confirmation of private SAMS eligibility is supplied.

coming.meta: Ndarboy Genk, Happy Asmara; Vision Pictures, Adglow Pictures and Hompimpa Sinema Nusantara: Jodilee Warwick and Erick Estrada support the principal cast; LSF supplies the official production identity.
coming.logline: A Yogyakarta café worker goes viral singing campursari, enters the music industry and confronts rivalry, ambition and changing relationships.
coming.quality: Quality unproven: the captured material establishes a 106-minute drama-comedy-musical with a 13+ classification, but contains no independent review, screening assessment or audience reaction to the completed film.
coming.gold: Focused regional upside: campursari, Jawa identity and established singers provide a clear audience hook, but the evidence supports targeted relevance rather than broad national conversion.
coming.promo: Active but concentrated campaign: a Yogyakarta press conference and gala premiere generated current publicity and social posts, without evidence of a broader roadshow or ticket-conversion activation.
coming.social: Visible but shallow social signal: title-tagged promotion reached thousands of views, yet comments and shares were sparse and the keyword sample contained ambiguous or unrelated results.
coming.demand: Demand unproven: the October 8 national release is well established, but the bundle contains no presale volume, cinema schedule depth, seat-map movement, sold-out screening or explicit buying behavior.
coming.risk: High execution risk despite a coherent niche: private SAMS eligibility is unresolved, completed-film quality is untested and the observable social activity is promotional rather than transactional.
coming.bet: Jawa-leaning sites will deliver higher paid admissions per show than the matched domestic-opening baseline by Day 4.
coming.nug: Campursari is the film’s story engine, not decoration: its clearest edge is the alignment of Jawa identity, sudden fame and established singers.

lanes.read: Accessible musical underdog story: a Yogyakarta café worker goes viral singing campursari, enters the music industry and faces rivalry, ambition and changing relationships.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The LSF synopsis directly describes Prita’s viral performance and subsequent entry into professional music.
lanes.decision_consequence: Position the film as a contemporary Jawa musical about sudden fame, not as a generic romance.

lanes.read: Recognizable Jawa-music talent: Ndarboy Genk and Happy Asmara lead alongside Jodilee Warwick and Erick Estrada; LSF names Vision Pictures, Adglow Pictures and Hompimpa Sinema Nusantara as producers.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The official LSF record supplies the cast and registered production companies; current press confirms the principal talent.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat the musicians as a targeted audience bridge in Jawa-leaning markets, but not as proven cinema draw.

lanes.read: Quality unproven: the captured material establishes a 106-minute drama-comedy-musical with a 13+ classification, but contains no independent review, screening assessment or audience reaction to the completed film.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF provides authoritative format, duration and classification facts, while the supposed quality sources remain descriptive or promotional rather than evaluative.
lanes.missing_fact: An independent completed-film review or attributable post-screening audience assessment.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not grant a quality-led floor; require Day 1 admissions and occupancy evidence if the title becomes eligible.

lanes.read: Focused regional upside: campursari, Jawa identity and established singers provide a clear audience hook, but the evidence supports targeted relevance rather than broad national conversion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The director says Jawa identity is built through speech, character and music, while Ndarboy links the story to ordinary Jawa career struggles.
lanes.decision_consequence: If booking is confirmed, prioritize sites with demonstrated Jawa-music affinity and test before expanding elsewhere.

lanes.read: Active but concentrated campaign: a Yogyakarta press conference and gala premiere generated current publicity and social posts, without evidence of a broader roadshow or ticket-conversion activation.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A September 28 press event is directly reported, and the captured social sample includes gala-premiere and repeated October 8 reminder posts.
lanes.decision_consequence: Credit the campaign with launch awareness, but do not translate publicity activity into an allocation floor.

lanes.read: Visible but shallow social signal: title-tagged promotion reached thousands of views, yet comments and shares were sparse and the keyword sample contained ambiguous or unrelated results.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A #cidroasmoro promotional post recorded 2,173 views, 46 likes, one comment and zero shares; other explicit title reminders were similarly modest.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use social as proof of some awareness, not audience breadth, purchase intent or a reason to expand shows.

lanes.read: Demand unproven: the October 8 national release is well established, but the bundle contains no presale volume, cinema schedule depth, seat-map movement, sold-out screening or explicit buying behavior.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Purchase-oriented searches produced release announcements rather than transactional evidence.
lanes.missing_fact: Current presale sales, booked SAMS schedules, seat-map movement or another direct purchase-proximity measure.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not make a demand-led allocation; if eligibility is confirmed, begin with a controlled test and Day 1 watch rule.

lanes.read: High execution risk despite a coherent niche: private SAMS eligibility is unresolved, completed-film quality is untested and the observable social activity is promotional rather than transactional.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The supplied title record lacks SAMS booking confirmation, while captured public evidence shows a campaign but no quality verdict or purchase signal.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title outside ordinary exploration allocation until Programming confirms eligibility; then cap exposure and watch actual admissions.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Strong identity and campaign evidence; no independent completed-film review or confirmed private SAMS booking.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Plausible Jawa-market fit, but SAMS eligibility is unconfirmed and the title is absent from the captured public Coming surface.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: the October 8 release is confirmed, but no presales, seat movement, schedule depth or buying behavior was captured.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Active but concentrated: Yogyakarta press and gala activity; title posts reached thousands but drew few comments or shares.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High: eligibility is unresolved, quality is untested and observable activity is promotional rather than transactional.
ai_rating.actionability: Confirm SAMS booking, then observe paid admissions per show and occupancy by site and session on Day 1 and Day 4.

eligibility.basis: The captured SAMS public Coming surface lists the title as approved, but that public surface is discovery evidence only and is not private booking, DCP or final eligibility truth. No explicit current Akhil or Programming eligibility confirmation is supplied.

coming.meta: Putri Marino, Arya Saloka, Christine Hakim — Forka Films: directed by Kamila Andini and produced by Ifa Isfansyah.
coming.logline: After twenty years in prison, a woman returns to the village that rejected her, confronting buried trauma and rebuilding her life among fellow outsiders.
coming.quality: Strong craft with a divisive payoff: captured festival reactions praise the visuals, performances and emotional force, while several viewers found the slow pace or late supernatural and UFO turn jarring.
coming.gold: Prestige-led adult proposition: festival selection, an established director and recognizable cast create a credible cinephile hook, but the severe subject matter and genre turn limit evidence for broad appeal.
coming.promo: Active launch campaign, not proven effectiveness: an official trailer and poster, press activity, gala-related content and an explicit day-one ticket call-to-action were captured before release.
coming.social: Visible but cast-led attention: sampled TikToks reached up to 137,857 views, yet the strongest posts center on Arya Saloka, gala moments and celebrity chemistry rather than explicit viewing intent.
coming.demand: Demand remains unproven: tickets were advertised as available and one report says limited screenings sold out, but there is insufficient evidence of title-level presales, seat movement or SAMS purchase behavior.
coming.risk: Eligibility and polarization are the material risks: SAMS booking truth is unresolved, while captured reactions warn that slow pacing, sexual-violence themes and the abrupt supernatural ending may narrow or split response.
coming.bet: If eligible, prestige-drama audiences will outperform the film's broad social signal, with visible post-viewing polarization.
coming.nug: Its edge is the tension between prestige craft and a late supernatural turn: the same ending may drive conversation and split response.

lanes.read: A woman returns to her village after twenty years in prison, confronting the people and buried trauma that shaped her exile while rebuilding a life among fellow outsiders.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: ANTARA’s captured synopsis directly identifies Pertiwi’s return, rejection by her family and village, and confrontation with her past.
lanes.decision_consequence: Frame it as a mature trauma-and-homecoming drama with mystery and revenge elements, not a conventional romance.

lanes.read: Recognizable prestige ensemble: Putri Marino leads with Arya Saloka and Christine Hakim, directed by Kamila Andini and produced by Ifa Isfansyah through Forka Films.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured production report names the director, producer, leading cast and Forka Films, with supporting production collaborators.
lanes.decision_consequence: The talent package is a credible awareness hook, but its reputation must not be treated as proof of ticket conversion.

lanes.read: Strong craft with a divisive payoff: captured festival reactions praise the visuals, performances and emotional force, while several viewers found the slow pace or late supernatural and UFO turn jarring.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Multiple readable Letterboxd reactions praise cinematography, sound, Putri Marino and emotional catharsis while independently questioning the final tonal shift.
lanes.decision_consequence: Expect meaningful positive word of mouth among receptive viewers alongside real polarization; monitor audience response rather than assuming prestige equals consensus.

lanes.read: Prestige-led adult proposition: festival selection, an established director and recognizable cast create a credible cinephile hook, but the severe subject matter and genre turn limit evidence for broad appeal.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Film Indonesia records Toronto, Tokyo and Busan selections; captured audience reactions show strong craft appreciation but divided responses to the ending.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat prestige as positioning value rather than a commercial floor; the room still needs eligibility and paid-behavior evidence.

lanes.read: Active launch campaign, not proven effectiveness: an official trailer and poster, press activity, gala-related content and an explicit day-one ticket call-to-action were captured before release.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The official Cinema XXI trailer asset passed capture, while current social samples include gala content and a post saying first-day tickets were available.
lanes.decision_consequence: Marketing activity is present, so the room should judge its conversion separately rather than treating campaign volume as demand.

lanes.read: Visible but cast-led attention: sampled TikToks reached up to 137,857 views, yet the strongest posts center on Arya Saloka, gala moments and celebrity chemistry rather than explicit viewing intent.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Nine TikTok samples include several five- and six-figure view counts, but comments, shares and captions are dominated by talent or event spillover.
lanes.decision_consequence: Count this as awareness, not audience commitment; it does not justify a demand or booking claim.

lanes.read: Demand remains unproven: tickets were advertised as available and one report says limited screenings sold out, but there is insufficient evidence of title-level presales, seat movement or SAMS purchase behavior.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A captured social post provides purchase proximity, while biem.co reports sold-out limited screenings without venue, capacity or comparable sales detail.
lanes.missing_fact: Confirmed SAMS eligibility plus title-level presales, seat inventory movement or paid admissions by site and showtime.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not convert publicity or limited-event scarcity into an ordinary exploration floor; keep the title awaiting private eligibility and measurable paid behavior.

lanes.read: Eligibility and polarization are the material risks: SAMS booking truth is unresolved, while captured reactions warn that slow pacing, sexual-violence themes and the abrupt supernatural ending may narrow or split response.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Readable festival-viewer reactions repeatedly identify the ending and pacing as possible breaks from the otherwise grounded, emotionally intense film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Resolve private eligibility first; if confirmed, make early audience response the decision trigger rather than relying on prestige or cast reach.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Medium: direct credits and campaign evidence are strong; current quality evidence comes from bounded festival reactions.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Low: SAMS public Coming lists it, but private booking, DCP and final eligibility remain unconfirmed.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: tickets were advertised and limited screenings reportedly sold out; no SAMS presales or paid admissions exist.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Medium: the campaign is active and TikToks reached 137,857 views, but attention is largely cast- and gala-led.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High: unresolved eligibility, slow pacing, sexual-violence themes and a divisive supernatural or UFO ending.
ai_rating.actionability: Medium: eligibility confirmation enables a Day 1 and Day 4 niche-quality test; present evidence cannot establish demand.

eligibility.basis: The captured SAMS public Coming surface lists the title as approved, but that public surface is discovery evidence only and is not private booking, DCP or final eligibility truth. No explicit current Akhil or Programming eligibility confirmation is supplied.

coming.meta: Rachel Amanda, Karina Salim, Marthino Lio, Kevin Ardilova / TUTA (The United Team of Art) Films: Ilya Sigma's feature-directing debut.
coming.logline: Four friends seeking healing in a remote forest are divided by mysterious walkie-talkie voices that turn buried trauma into paranoia.
coming.quality: Quality remains insufficient evidence: the daytime, sound-driven psychological-horror design is distinctive, but the only readable audience review says the personal, anti-mainstream approach did not land.
coming.gold: Differentiated but narrow proposition: daytime forest horror built around sound, mistrust and four recognizable actors can stand apart, yet its restrained psychological approach may underserve mainstream ghost-horror expectations.
coming.promo: Active campaign, not demand proof: TUTA Films released trailer and poster, the leads completed a Republika media visit, and creator collaborations were active immediately before release.
coming.social: Creator spillover dominates: two Side Brothers-linked posts reached 47,790 and 20,349 views, while plot-led posts reached only 268–4,773 views with minimal comments and shares.
coming.demand: Ticket demand is insufficient evidence: sources confirm the October 8 release, but no presale, seat-map, sold-out session, booking velocity or explicit purchase-intent signal was captured.
coming.risk: High conversion and execution risk: creator-led engagement may overstate film demand, the sole readable audience reaction is adverse, and private SAMS eligibility remains unresolved.
coming.bet: If privately eligible, HASUT will remain below the domestic-horror admissions-per-show baseline through Day 4.
coming.nug: Distinctive daylight, sound-led paranoia: one adverse audience reaction questions whether its restrained, personal approach connects.

lanes.read: Four friends seeking healing in a remote forest are divided by mysterious voices transmitted through their walkie-talkies, turning buried trauma into paranoia.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Multiple readable sources consistently describe four companions, a forest healing ritual and manipulative voices transmitted through an HT.
lanes.decision_consequence: The premise is clear and differentiated enough for concise audience-facing positioning around psychological distrust rather than conventional ghost spectacle.

lanes.read: Recognizable ensemble, emerging filmmaker: Rachel Amanda, Karina Salim, Marthino Lio and Kevin Ardilova lead TUTA Films' feature-directing debut from Ilya Sigma.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Fetched coverage directly names the four leads, TUTA Films and Ilya Sigma, while identifying the film as his directing debut.
lanes.decision_consequence: The cast offers credible recognition, but neither the director nor production-house evidence supports treating the title as automatic event cinema.

lanes.read: Quality remains insufficient evidence: the daytime, sound-driven psychological-horror design is distinctive, but the only readable audience review says the personal, anti-mainstream approach did not land.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A readable Letterboxd page contains one adverse audience reaction; favorable quality language elsewhere is largely promotional or talent-based rather than independent evaluation.
lanes.missing_fact: A broader set of independent post-screening reviews or verified audience reactions assessing execution, tension and satisfaction.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not upgrade the title on claimed originality alone; treat the concept as promising but execution-sensitive until Day 1 audience evidence appears.

lanes.read: Differentiated but narrow proposition: daytime forest horror built around sound, mistrust and four recognizable actors can stand apart, yet its restrained psychological approach may underserve mainstream ghost-horror expectations.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Readable coverage consistently positions voice manipulation, paranoia and daytime forest tension as the film's central distinction.
lanes.decision_consequence: If privately eligible, present it as a controlled trial with an explicit watch rule for whether concept differentiation converts beyond cast and creator followers.

lanes.read: Active campaign, not demand proof: TUTA Films released trailer and poster, the leads completed a Republika media visit, and creator collaborations were active immediately before release.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Readable coverage documents the trailer/poster launch and a September 8 media visit; the captured TikTok sample shows coordinated creator-led promotion on October 3.
lanes.decision_consequence: Expect awareness support near opening, but do not convert campaign volume into a booking or allocation claim without paid-intent evidence.

lanes.read: Creator spillover dominates: two Side Brothers-linked posts reached 47,790 and 20,349 views, while plot-led posts reached only 268–4,773 views with minimal comments and shares.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The ten-post TikTok sample shows the largest engagement attached to creator/job narratives, not to the film premise itself.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat the visible social peak as collaboration reach rather than broad title pull; watch conversion on film-led posts and actual admissions.

lanes.read: Ticket demand is insufficient evidence: sources confirm the October 8 release, but no presale, seat-map, sold-out session, booking velocity or explicit purchase-intent signal was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The closest readable evidence is release-date promotion; the social sample measures reach and engagement, not ticket action.
lanes.missing_fact: Current presale transactions, seat occupancy, confirmed cinema schedules or audience statements showing concrete intent to buy.
lanes.decision_consequence: No ordinary exploration floor or demand-led allocation case is justified; private eligibility must be confirmed before even a controlled trial is discussed.

lanes.read: High conversion and execution risk: creator-led engagement may overstate film demand, the sole readable audience reaction is adverse, and private SAMS eligibility remains unresolved.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Direct social data separates creator popularity from plot interest, while the only readable audience review questions whether the unconventional theme connects.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the room from treating public Coming visibility or campaign reach as confirmed eligibility, quality or demand; require owner confirmation and Day 1 evidence.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Strong on premise, cast, promo and sampled social; thin on independent quality and ticket action.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Public SAMS Coming corroborates discovery, but private booking and DCP eligibility remain unconfirmed.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: no presale, seat-map, sold-out, booking-velocity or purchase-intent evidence was captured.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Active but creator-led: 47,790 and 20,349 views versus 268–4,773 for plot-led posts.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High: creator reach may overstate demand, while the sole readable audience reaction is adverse.
ai_rating.actionability: Resolve private eligibility, then measure admissions per show against the current-week domestic-horror baseline.

eligibility.basis: The captured SAMS public Coming surface lists the title as approved, but that public surface is discovery evidence only and is not private booking, DCP or final eligibility truth. No explicit current Akhil or Programming eligibility confirmation is supplied. The captured credits do not identify Rapi Films, so the standing producer exclusion is not asserted from absent evidence.

coming.meta: Lukman Sardi, Jerome Kurnia and Paragon Pictures: returning leads in a Rizal Mantovani film produced with Ideosource Entertainment and Virtuelines Entertainment.
coming.logline: Romo Thomas and Romo Rendra confront Rephaim, an ancient entity unleashed through an ancestral blood pact.
coming.quality: Polished scale, unproven execution: the 117-minute, 13+ religious-horror sequel carries IMAX positioning and expanded production scope, but no captured independent review evaluates the finished film.
coming.gold: Accessible event-horror proposition: returning priests, a larger supernatural threat, a 13+ classification and IMAX exhibition broaden the sequel beyond a niche religious-horror pitch.
coming.promo: Active cast-and-format campaign: a limited-premiere press event, cast interviews and repeated IMAX messaging supplied concrete publicity immediately before the October 8 release.
coming.social: Visible but campaign-led social activity: the captured ten-post TikTok sample totaled 16,778 views and 1,063 likes, yet only three comments; one post supplied 11,598 views and 715 likes.
coming.demand: Purchase proximity without proven demand: an aggregator displayed detailed October 8 Jakarta showtimes and formats, but no readable capture reports presale volume, seat fill, sellouts or booking velocity.
coming.risk: Conversion risk, not awareness risk: premium-format publicity and campaign posts are visible, but independent quality, meaningful audience conversation and ticket-sales evidence remain insufficient.
coming.bet: Sequel recognition and 13+ IMAX positioning can deliver a viable opening, but a breakout requires strong Day 1 word of mouth.
coming.nug: Premium-format reach is unusually broad for the premise, but 16,778 TikTok views produced only three comments.

lanes.read: Religious-exorcism sequel: Romo Thomas and Romo Rendra confront Rephaim, an ancient entity unleashed through an ancestral blood pact.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Film Indonesia’s captured synopsis directly identifies the two priests, Rephaim and the ancestral blood pact.
lanes.decision_consequence: The clear supernatural threat and returning-priest structure give the room a simple, marketable premise.

lanes.read: Recognizable returning leads and substantial production backing: Lukman Sardi and Jerome Kurnia lead a Paragon Pictures, Ideosource Entertainment and Virtuelines Entertainment production.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The LSF record directly lists the production companies, producers Robert Ronny and Prima Taufik, director Rizal Mantovani and principal cast.
lanes.decision_consequence: Returning leads and a multi-company domestic production support visibility, but do not establish audience demand.

lanes.read: Polished scale, unproven execution: the 117-minute, 13+ religious-horror sequel carries IMAX positioning and expanded production scope, but no captured independent review evaluates the finished film.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF confirms runtime, classification, production scale and IMAX presentation; these are production facts rather than a quality verdict.
lanes.missing_fact: A readable independent review or post-screening audience assessment of the finished film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat premium-format ambition as a presentation advantage, not grounds for assuming strong word of mouth or retention.

lanes.read: Accessible event-horror proposition: returning priests, a larger supernatural threat, a 13+ classification and IMAX exhibition broaden the sequel beyond a niche religious-horror pitch.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF verifies the 13+ classification and IMAX scale, while ANTARA confirms nationwide release positioning and returning characters.
lanes.decision_consequence: If privately eligible, position it as a recognizable, premium-format sequel; do not treat that positioning as evidence for an aggressive floor.

lanes.read: Active cast-and-format campaign: a limited-premiere press event, cast interviews and repeated IMAX messaging supplied concrete publicity immediately before the October 8 release.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: ANTARA’s captured report documents the Gandaria press conference and cast discussion of the IMAX presentation and production process.
lanes.decision_consequence: Awareness support is present, but the room should not convert publicity activity into an assumption of ticket demand.

lanes.read: Visible but campaign-led social activity: the captured ten-post TikTok sample totaled 16,778 views and 1,063 likes, yet only three comments; one post supplied 11,598 views and 715 likes.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured TikTok keyword sample shows concentrated reach, respectable lightweight reactions and almost no conversation.
lanes.decision_consequence: Count this as directional awareness with shallow demonstrated audience dialogue, not organic momentum or purchase intent.

lanes.read: Purchase proximity without proven demand: an aggregator displayed detailed October 8 Jakarta showtimes and formats, but no readable capture reports presale volume, seat fill, sellouts or booking velocity.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Jadwalnonton displayed dated sessions across regular, IMAX and 4DX screens; this establishes availability rather than sales strength.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified presale transactions, occupied-seat counts, sellout evidence or comparable booking velocity.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not infer a strong opening or assign an ordinary exploration floor until private eligibility and actual booking evidence are confirmed.

lanes.read: Conversion risk, not awareness risk: premium-format publicity and campaign posts are visible, but independent quality, meaningful audience conversation and ticket-sales evidence remain insufficient.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The TikTok sample produced only three comments despite 16,778 views, while the readable film sources offer specifications and promotion rather than independent appraisal.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title monitored and conditional on private eligibility; require Day 1 evidence before expanding from any owner-approved opening position.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Strong identity and campaign evidence; no independent finished-film review.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Public SAMS Coming listing exists; private booking, DCP and final eligibility remain unconfirmed.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: October 8 regular, IMAX and 4DX sessions are visible; sales, seat fill and booking velocity are missing.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Press, cast and IMAX publicity are active; TikTok reaction is concentrated and conversation is shallow.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: Conversion is the central risk: awareness is visible, while quality and ticket demand remain unproven.
ai_rating.actionability: Day 1 and Day 4 occupancy can test the thesis once private eligibility and a matched baseline are confirmed.

what_milo_sees.title: KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH
what_milo_sees.insight: Measured: October 8 regular, IMAX and 4DX sessions are visible, but sales and seat fill are absent. Prediction: it is closest to purchase, not yet the demand leader. Unresolved: private eligibility and conversion; HASUT has no ticket action.
what_milo_sees.room_question: If KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH and HASUT are both eligible, does KUASA's visible schedule translate into higher full-price regular-format admissions per show at common sites and matched dayparts on Day 1 and Day 4?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH leads HASUT in full-price regular-format admissions per show on both Day 1 and Day 4 across common eligible sites and matched dayparts; premium performance is reported separately.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: HASUT matches or exceeds KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH on either day under the same regular-format denominator, or KUASA's apparent lead exists only in premium formats.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: If eligibility, common-site exposure or matched dayparts are absent, record no comparative winner; keep KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH as closest to purchase, not proven demand.

public_signal_shape.comparison: Regular, IMAX and 4DX sessions are visible; no other accepted title section records comparable session visibility.

what_milo_sees.evidence: Returning leads, a 13+ classification and premium-format positioning support recognition, while 16,778 TikTok views produced only three comments and no ticket conversion evidence.

what_milo_sees.title: CIDRO ASMORO
what_milo_sees.insight: Measured: Jawa identity runs through CIDRO ASMORO’s language, music and talent; conversion is absent. Prediction: affinity can create local outperformance. Unresolved: eligibility. EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI instead offers prestige craft with a divisive ending.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Before Day 1, can Programming name at least two CIDRO ASMORO affinity sites and two comparison sites from documented prior same-site Jawa-language or music-title performance, and is EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI booked?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: CIDRO ASMORO leads in the predeclared affinity group versus comparison sites on matched full-price regular admissions per show through Day 4; EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI shows a mixed site pattern with stable Day 4 pockets.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: CIDRO ASMORO shows no predeclared group difference, or groups are chosen after results; EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI loses occupancy broadly by Day 4 without a positive quality pocket.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Without predeclared groups, do not claim CIDRO ASMORO local superiority. Read EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI only on its own Day 1-to-Day 4 matched-site retention and audience-response evidence.

public_signal_shape.comparison: CIDRO ASMORO has explicit Jawa and campursari alignment; EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI’s accepted edge is prestige craft and polarized response.

what_milo_sees.evidence: CIDRO ASMORO embeds campursari and Jawa identity in its story and principal talent, but title posts drew few comments or shares. EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI has cast-led reach and bounded festival reactions, not paid SAMS demand.

what_milo_sees.title: HASUT
what_milo_sees.insight: Measured: HASUT drew 47,790 and 20,349 views on creator-linked posts versus 268–4,773 on plot-led posts. Prediction: reach may overstate broad demand. Unresolved: paid conversion. EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI’s cast-led reach carries a similar caveat.
what_milo_sees.room_question: At common eligible sites and matched dayparts, does HASUT's creator-led reach convert enough to match KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH on full-price regular-format admissions per show on Day 1 or Day 4?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: HASUT trails KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH on both days across common eligible sites, while no non-creator purchase signal emerges.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: HASUT matches or exceeds KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH on either day under common exposure, showing creator concentration did not prevent paid conversion.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: If the titles lack common eligible sites, matched dayparts or separable full-price admissions, make no relative call; creator-linked reach remains awareness evidence only.

public_signal_shape.comparison: Creator-linked posts recorded 47,790 and 20,349 views; plot-led posts recorded 268–4,773.

what_milo_sees.evidence: The within-title campaign contrast is large and no presale, seat-map, sold-out or purchase-intent evidence was captured. EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI’s reach is also described as largely cast- and gala-led.

title_hypotheses.title: CIDRO ASMORO
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If privately eligible and Programming predeclares at least two affinity sites and two comparison sites from documented prior same-site Jawa-language or music-title performance before Day 1, CIDRO ASMORO will record higher full-price regular-format admissions per show in the affinity group through Day 4.
title_hypotheses.evidence: Jawa identity is embedded in the speech, characters, campursari music and principal talent, creating a specific affinity hypothesis despite weak conversion evidence.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if CIDRO ASMORO does not lead the predeclared affinity group over comparison sites on matched full-price regular-format admissions per show by Day 4; without predeclared groups, classify the test as unresolvable, not supportive.

measurement.comparison: Before results, bind both groups to documented prior same-site evidence. At matched dayparts on Day 1 and Day 4, compare full-price regular-format admissions per show, with at least two eligible sites per group; never classify sites after outcomes.

title_hypotheses.title: EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If privately eligible, EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI will show a polarized niche pattern: some matched sites will hold or improve full-price same-daypart occupancy from Day 1 to Day 4 while others decline, alongside both positive craft and negative pacing or ending responses.
title_hypotheses.evidence: Festival viewers praise the craft and emotional force but split on pacing and the ending; social reach is visible yet cast-led, while SAMS paid behavior is absent.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if the Day 1-to-Day 4 occupancy direction is uniform across matched eligible sites or verified audience response is not polarized; absent matched exposures or response evidence, classify the result as unresolved.

measurement.comparison: Within each eligible site, compare full-price occupancy at matched dayparts on Day 1 and Day 4; report counts of improving, stable and declining sites and separately record verified reactions to craft, pacing and the ending.

title_hypotheses.title: HASUT
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If both titles are privately eligible, HASUT will trail KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH on full-price regular-format admissions per show on Day 1 and Day 4 at common SAMS sites and matched dayparts; creator-led reach will not become broader paid conversion.
title_hypotheses.evidence: The campaign is active and the concept is differentiated, but engagement falls sharply outside creator-linked posts and no ticket action is visible.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if HASUT matches or exceeds KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH on full-price regular-format admissions per show on either Day 1 or Day 4 across their common eligible sites and matched dayparts.

measurement.comparison: At common eligible sites, aggregate full-price regular-format admissions and shows separately for matched dayparts, compare admissions per show on Day 1 and Day 4, exclude event or promotional traffic, and report premium formats separately.

title_hypotheses.title: KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If both titles are privately eligible, KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH will lead HASUT on full-price regular-format admissions per show on Day 1 and Day 4 at common SAMS sites and matched dayparts; a regular-format lead, not IMAX or 4DX visibility, would support conversion.
title_hypotheses.evidence: Returning priests, a 13+ classification and IMAX positioning support recognition and accessibility; shallow social dialogue limits confidence in conversion.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if HASUT matches or exceeds KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH on full-price regular-format admissions per show on either day, or if KUASA's apparent advantage exists only in premium formats.

measurement.comparison: At common eligible sites, compare full-price regular-format admissions per show at matched dayparts on Day 1 and Day 4, exclude event or promotional traffic, and keep IMAX and 4DX results in a separate format view.

research_coverage.title: EMPAT MUSIM PERTIWI

official_identity.finding: Recognizable prestige ensemble: Putri Marino leads with Arya Saloka and Christine Hakim, directed by Kamila Andini and produced by Ifa Isfansyah through Forka Films.

trailer_comments.finding: Visible but cast-led attention: sampled TikToks reached up to 137,857 views, yet the strongest posts center on Arya Saloka, gala moments and celebrity chemistry rather than explicit viewing intent.

independent_quality.finding: Strong craft with a divisive payoff: captured festival reactions praise the visuals, performances and emotional force, while several viewers found the slow pace or late supernatural and UFO turn jarring.

promo.finding: Active launch campaign, not proven effectiveness: an official trailer and poster, press activity, gala-related content and an explicit day-one ticket call-to-action were captured before release.

direct_demand.finding: Demand remains unproven: tickets were advertised as available and one report says limited screenings sold out, but there is insufficient evidence of title-level presales, seat movement or SAMS purchase behavior.
direct_demand.blocker: Demand remains unproven: tickets were advertised as available and one report says limited screenings sold out, but there is insufficient evidence of title-level presales, seat movement or SAMS purchase behavior.

adverse.finding: Eligibility and polarization are the material risks: SAMS booking truth is unresolved, while captured reactions warn that slow pacing, sexual-violence themes and the abrupt supernatural ending may narrow or split response.

awareness.read: Awareness is visible in sampled TikTok reach, including posts above 100,000 views, but much of that reach attaches to Arya Saloka, gala behavior and celebrity interaction rather than the film proposition.

engagement.read: Likes, comments and shares are present, including 4,571 likes and 95 shares on one gala clip, but the bounded sample is cast-led and cannot establish representative film engagement.

quality.read: Readable festival-viewer reactions provide genuine current-film evidence: craft and performances are praised, while pacing and the final genre turn divide viewers. No representative critic aggregate was captured.

promo.read: The campaign includes an official trailer and poster, press and gala activity, cast-centered social content and a direct first-day ticket call-to-action; effectiveness remains separate.

demand.read: Tickets were explicitly advertised as available and limited screenings were reported sold out, but no general-release presale count, seat map, venue capacity or SAMS transaction evidence was captured.

lane_support.gap: Demand remains unproven: tickets were advertised as available and one report says limited screenings sold out, but there is insufficient evidence of title-level presales, seat movement or SAMS purchase behavior.

non_consensus_hypothesis.title: KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH
non_consensus_hypothesis.hypothesis: If both titles are privately eligible, KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH will exceed HASUT on full-price regular-format admissions per show on both Day 1 and Day 4 at common SAMS sites and matched dayparts, despite HASUT's larger creator-linked public peaks.
non_consensus_hypothesis.evidence: KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH has visible October 8 regular, IMAX and 4DX sessions, returning leads and a 13+ classification. HASUT's two largest sampled posts are creator-linked, its plot-led posts reached 268-4,773 views, and no ticket action was captured. Neither title has proven SAMS demand.
non_consensus_hypothesis.why_non_consensus: A raw-reach reading could favor HASUT's 47,790- and 20,349-view creator-linked peaks. This hypothesis discounts those peaks and tests the slate's only observed schedule signal instead of treating creator reach as conversion.
non_consensus_hypothesis.why_stronger_than_alternative: KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH's dated regular, IMAX and 4DX sessions are closer to purchase than HASUT's creator or job-content reach. KUASA's shallow conversation and absent sales keep confidence low; they do not erase the evidence-order advantage.
non_consensus_hypothesis.falsifier: At common eligible SAMS sites and matched dayparts, HASUT matches or exceeds KUASA GELAP: PERJANJIAN DARAH on full-price regular-format admissions per show on either Day 1 or Day 4.
